title: CampusBite: Canteen Order Analytics
context: Campus canteens now take UPI orders on a tablet. The manager wants to know which items sell, when the rush comes, and whether customers are being double-charged.
input: Orders as parallel arrays: time (minutes since 8:00), item id (0..39), amount (Rs), UPI transaction id.

milestones.title: Catch double charges
milestones.requirement: Find UPI transaction ids that appear more than once (a payment app retried). Compare an O(n²) scan with a count array.

milestones.title: Combo builder
milestones.requirement: Pick menu items whose prices fit a Rs 150 budget as closely as possible (subset sum with a memo table).

milestones.title: Revenue between two times
milestones.requirement: Per-slot revenue with a prefix array; answer 'revenue from 12:30 to 13:15' in O(1).

milestones.title: Find the lunch rush
milestones.requirement: The busiest 30-minute window by revenue, sliding over per-10-minute totals.

milestones.title: Orders in a time slot
milestones.requirement: Times are appended in order: count orders in [12:00, 13:00) with two lower bounds.

milestones.title: Counter queue simulation
milestones.requirement: Simulate the token queue (FIFO) and report waiting times; compare 1 and 2 counters.
